help.jumpHost: An intermediate proxy server (bastion) used to securely connect to YDB cluster hosts located in a private network.
help.ydbDomain: The root domain path for the YDB cluster. All databases and schemas will be created under this root path.
help.coresStatic: Number of CPU cores allocated per storage node for YDB cluster operations (static nodes running Blob Storage and system tablets).
help.enforceUserToken: Enforces mandatory user token authentication. If enabled, anonymous requests are rejected and all connections must provide a valid token.
help.requestClientCert: Requires dynamic nodes to present a trusted client certificate (mTLS) to register and join the cluster, preventing unauthorized nodes from connecting.
help.affinityStatic: CPU affinity settings for static nodes. Restricts the YDB storage daemon process to specific CPU cores using systemd CPUAffinity.
help.coresDynamic: Number of CPU cores allocated per dynamic node for database tablet execution and user query processing.
help.dbName: The name of the database to be created. Example: 'my-database'. It will be automatically placed under the configured root domain.
help.dbGroups: Number of storage groups allocated for the database. Storage groups are independent units of Blob Storage providing data redundancy.
help.affinityDynamic: CPU affinity settings for dynamic nodes. Restricts the database query execution process to specific CPU cores using systemd CPUAffinity.
help.ydbCli: The YDB command-line interface (CLI) used to interact with the YDB cluster — create databases, execute queries, manage schemas, and run scripts.
help.ydbd: The YDB server daemon (ydbd). This is the main storage and database process that runs on each cluster node.
help.ydbops: A low-level administrative tool (ydbops) for direct manipulation of YDB cluster nodes — maintenance, restart, and diagnostics operations.
help.dstool: A distributed storage management tool (dstool) for inspecting and managing YDB Blob Storage groups, disks, and VDisks.
help.systemRequirements: Hardware and software requirements for YDB cluster deployment.
